title: HPDG 808 1.0.2
notes: HPDG 808 1.0.2: the 200 factory presets made again from a full fitting run over 1309 real 808 recordings, each closer to the 808 it was made from; same names and levels. HPDG 808 is the bass instrument from HPDG as its own VST3 and Standalone for Windows: 200 presets by genre and substyle, an 808 synth with Punch, Tone Fall and Swell, a sample layer, a saturator, a mastering section for bass (MASTER) and Export WAV / drag of the finished one-shot.
